intents.text: Can you build me a simple dashboard to track my daily water intake and workout habits?
Create an interactive calculator app where I can input my monthly income and expenses to see budget breakdown charts.
Generate a UI for an event RSVP app where users can fill in their name, dietary restrictions, and plus-one details.
Please have Vendo's agent handle processing all pending customer refund requests end-to-end and give me a summary.
Delegate the task of auditing our inventory discrepancies and generating any required approvals to the Vendo agent.
I need Vendo to run a full store data cleanup task autonomously from start to finish and report back when it's done.
What is the capital city of France and what are its top three tourist attractions?
Can you explain the difference between synchronous and asynchronous programming in Python?
